description: Change a product's name, description, price, pricing mode or categories. On a rikma product the terms (name, description, price) become an edit proposal to the partners (editObject): the result has proposalId, silenceApprovesAt (when silence approves it at the rikma's restime) and voteUrl — you never approve it. On a personal product, or in a rikma of one, everything applies at once. Categories always apply at once. One open proposal per product: if one is already open, answer it first. Members only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#proposeProductEditTool

categories.description: Replace the categories (ids from listRikmaCategories). Operational — applied at once.

pricingMode.description: Personal products only: a rikma product's pricing mode changes its recipe and is changed in the moach.

projectId.description: Rikma (project) id, from findUserProjectsTool. You must be a member.

reason.description: Why — shown to the partners on the proposal.

name: proposeProductEditTool
